title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta12

## Mowing report sensors from the private cloud

This beta promotes the proven Navimow mowing-report endpoints from the explicit development probe into bounded production polling and exposes the resulting statistics as optional Home Assistant sensors.

- Read `/vehicle/report/vehicle-main-report` for lifetime mowing area/time totals.
- Read `/vehicle/report/get-day-week-month-data` for daily, weekly and monthly mowing area/time totals using the proven query types 1, 2 and 3.
- Poll report data at a slow one-hour TTL with the existing last-known-good endpoint cache so report failures cannot disturb mower state or the core private-cloud polling loop.
- Keep the existing `weekly_mowed_area` sensor key/unique ID, but switch its canonical value to the new report source. The previous location-based weekly counter remains a conservative fallback until a valid report value is available.
- Group report entities consistently as `Mowed area ...` and `Mowed time ...`: today, this week, this month and total.
- Keep all report sensors disabled by default, including the existing weekly area sensor on new installs; users can enable only the statistics they want.
- Period sensors use reset-aware total semantics, while lifetime total sensors remain total-increasing.
- Include cached report rows in normal sanitized Home Assistant diagnostics for field verification.
